visual_review.notes: Reviewed all992 original extracted frames chronologically, enlarged hook grips/rope/alpha edges, both attack joins, all248 selected native phases and eight retained idle poses, plus three offscreen candidate battle renders. Reciprocal gait, backward recoil/recovery, held hook/palm guard, physical rope-loop support and grounded side fall retain identity and fixed anatomical scale. Abrupt initial attack windup and compressed swing excluded; dedicated original windup/strike videos join to the valid recovery. Candidate focused Windows checks836 pass, zero failures. Review uses complete chronological frames and native phase renders, not continuous playback or manual playtesting.
